resources.string: These are supported features, not extra permissions. Available actions depend on the signed roles, router version and connection.

Managed phones: signed offline policy, app limits, Downtime and DNS status. Assigned parents: LAN requests, approvals, new-app decisions and reported usage. Recorded-day history needs core 0.13.0-r24 or newer; installed-app lists need core r26; scoped standing app-rule changes need core r27 and administrator-activated core configuration. Ulysses status uses verified policy; frozen waiting/window details need core r25.

Rule, schedule, DNS, home-internet and bonus editing; phone enrollment; voyage creation, extension and amendment. Manual internet blocks stay until changed/reset. Timed tickets return to the normal rules, not necessarily the previous manual block.
Open the router web interface, sign in as administrator and choose FamilyWarden. Network access is required. Parent approval scope does not grant router administration.
Not yet available in this app

Other native parent editors and bonus controls; native voyage self-service; Lock now; independent adult voyages; categories and the adult pool; website history; off-home push delivery. Longer history ranges and historical rule/bonus attribution are not provided. There are no working buttons for these future features.
